notes.title: Pirates Outlaws V2.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]New Mode - BOUNTIES[/h2]
BOUNTIES that can defeat 9 Captains and crew across the seas in a unique battle.
[h2]New Island - BAZAAR[/h2]
BAZAAR island with new choice Enchant, Copy and Transform added on the map.

[h2]Fixed bugs[/h2]
1. Curse Captain had 54 HP with the Upgrade "Health".
2. Only +1 attack damage when had the relic "Puzzle" and "Last Piece".
3. The "Sword Master" skin and the “Chicken” skin of "First Mate" couldn’t get armor when max HP was reduced in Arena 40.
[h2]UI optimizations[/h2]

notes.title: Pirates Outlaws V2.00 Patch Notes | Happy 3rd Anniversary!
notes.content:
New character: First Mate.
New function: Now some relics can be enchanted.
Arena update: Add new function “Caravan”. Add new events and relics. Add new choices after Arena 50.
New function for collection: Tips for discovering and unlock cards and relics.
Action Point update: When Action Point is 0, the ship will not sink based on chance. Player can still continue to move on the map, but will lose HP. The first time 10 HP, the second time 15 HP, the third time and after 20 HP. Then the ship will sink when there is not enough HP.
Repute icon update.

[b]Fixed bug:[/b]
1. Quitting the game when use Alchemist to fuse cards in Tavern would cause some problem.
2. The relic “Feather” didn’t work on the relic “Pearl”.
3. There would be bug when using card “Double Kick” against the mechanical scorpion enemy in Port Elysia.

[b]Cards optimization:[/b]
1. Lethal Shot: damage 6 → 7 (upgraded 9 → 10), defeat enemy with HP below 12 → 14 (upgraded 18 → 20).
2. Silver Shot: damage 6 → 7 (upgraded 9 → 10).
3. Back Against Wall: Increase damage for each curse card 5 → 6 (upgraded 6 → 8).
4. Undead Killer: damage 8 → 10 (upgraded 12 → 13).
5. Good Rest: Heal 4 → 5 (upgraded 6 → 7).
6. Temperance: Add function “reload 1”  (upgraded reload 1 → 2).
7. Recycle Ammo: Reload 1 → 2 (upgraded 2 → 3).
8. Roulette Game: Upgraded version Mark 1 → 2, add keyword “Removed”.
9. Shore Menace: Put 1 card back from your hand to draw pile → Put a card from your hand on top of draw pile.
10. Hurricane: damage 12 → 15.
11. Tentacles: damage 20 → 30.
12. Harvest: Heal 20 → 30.
13. Scissors: Deals 8(upgraded 12) damage and deals 4 damage to the enemy behind the target.
14. Paper: damage 7 → 8 (upgraded 10 → 11).
15. Explosive Barrel: damage 9 → 11 (upgraded 13 → 15).
16. Shoot: damage 6 → 7 (upgraded 9 → 10).
17. Standard shoot: damage 7 → 8 (upgraded 10 → 11).
18. Double Shot: damage 6 → 7 (upgraded 9 → 10).

[b]Relic optimization:[/b]
1. Scorching Shell: -1 max hand size → -10 max HP.
2. Empty Bottle: Add function “Can’t be removed”.

notes.title: Pirates Outlaws is Out Now!
notes.content:
Ahoy, pirates!

After a long journey, Pirates Outlaws has now officially left Early Access!

We'd like to thank you all for your contribution during this time. It's your support that helped us make Pirates Outlaws becoming better.

Let's sail!

The new updates are as followed:

[b]1. New Arena[/b]
        - All 6 chapter's cards and relics;
        - New Champions to defeat (Arena 50 to 100)
        - New Actions and Events after battle
        - 6 New trophies

[b]2. New Hero[/b]
        - New hero "Doctor" joins the crew

[b]3. UI Improvements[/b]
        - More keywords have been added in the Glossary.
        - Quest panel differentiation (Common | Hero)
        - Tutorial have been improved
        - Logs panel implemented (You can now check your last 10 game summaries from the All Best    panel)
        - Hero Abilities can be reached from their avatars

[b]4. Enemy Classes[/b]
         - In order to help and inform players, all enemies classes will be shown during a battle.

 [b]5. Re- banlancing[/b]
         - Rewards and difficulties have been adjusted for each chapter.

[b]6. Reset of All Best Time in Arena [/b]
         - The new Arena come with a brand new challenge and new difficulty. We consider that all best time done from previous version should be reset.

notes.title: Pirates Outlaws lands on Steam
notes.content:
Ahoy Captains! The popular mobile card game Pirates Outlaws lands on Steam. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34680655/0be0c4ab0a50f117add865632d3adb917579aec4.jpg[/img]

For this version we have make a partnership with BlueStacks. They are supporting us, and they will do their best to give you the greatest game experience possible as well as we are doing it since the beginning. 

The game will be available in early access end of this month, August 28th for 19.99$.

[b]Few things you must know about this version:[/b]

1. As an early access version, it should come with issues that we are engaged to fix ASAP in priority.
2. NO cross-platform synchronization will be expected.
3. The game offers a new game experience without shop, gold or in-app purchases.
4. Progression and Reputation gain has been increased.
5. Quests, mainly related to gold winning, will be an exclusive feature to mobile versions. All characters will be available. As well as Navigate and Arena stay unchanged. 
6. All planned future content will be added to the game for free. This includes new chapters, characters, cards and relics.

The main purpose of this version will be to make you discover or rediscover the game.
Do not miss the release date. Get notified when it becomes available. Add it to your wishlist now!
